1 // Gandalf runtime host — the deterministic SEAM-PASS composer (Tier-1).
2 //
3 // THE MISSING RUNTIME (journal/0001 + LESSONS.md). The first real Gandalf cycles proved the model
4 // produces excellent DIAGNOSE/SITUATE/ANTICIPATE *content* but, run as pure SKILL.md prose, keeps
5 // hand-approximating the tier stamps and failing the B-honesty canary. Root cause: the honest tiers +
6 // refutation stamps are meant to be APPLIED DETERMINISTICALLY by the shipped seams, not produced by
7 // the model. This module is that wiring: it takes the model's RAW draft (un-stamped findings /
8 // elevations / diagnosis) and runs it through the already-shipped `seam/*.mjs` to produce a
9 // canary-conformant, honestly-graded advisor output that passes `assertIncrement1Conformant` by
10 // construction.
11 //
12 // SCOPE = Tier 1 (deterministic), by design (planning/runtime-host/DESCRIPTION.md):
13 //   • ONE model run, the deterministic seam pass — NO live independent named-defeater refuters and NO
14 //     researchPrime SITUATE commission (that needs the `agent()` seam the repo flags as the integration
15 //     point the gate never runs). So every ELEVATION honestly lands at SPECULATIVE carrying the
16 //     NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP — the seam's own honest floor (`vetElevationRefutation`). The
17 //     live-refuter PROMISING tier is a sequenced follow-on (needs `agent()`). NOT in this effort.
18 //   • DIAGNOSE findings keep their evidence rungs + `gandalf_core` provenance; `risk_labels` are capped
19 //     at the single-family PROMISING ceiling (`composeRiskLabels`, cross_model:false). Only REFUTED drops.
20 //
21 // REUSES (never forks) the shipped engine — it invents NO grading logic. A malformed/partial raw draft
22 // produces an HONEST named error (`SeamPassInputError`), never a fabricated finding or a forged output.
23 
24 import {
25   vetElevationRefutation,
26 } from '../seam/refute.mjs';
27 import { createCommissionLedger } from '../seam/commission-ledger.mjs';
28 import {
29   labelTier,
30   composeRiskLabels,
31   dropsFromOutput,
32 } from '../seam/score-label.mjs';
33 import { stampDiagnoseCoreProvenance } from '../seam/diagnose-core.mjs';
34 import { composeAnticipation } from '../seam/anticipate.mjs';
35 import { composeSituate } from '../seam/situate.mjs';
36 
37 /** The committed schema version (prereg-constants.json / fixtures.mjs `emptyConformantOutput`). */
38 export const SCHEMA_VERSION = 'gandalf-advisor-1';
39 
40 /** Thrown when the supplied raw draft is malformed/partial. A distinct, NAMED class so the host can
41  *  fail HONESTLY (no fabricated finding, no forged conformant output) and the caller can discriminate
42  *  an input problem from an internal seam failure. */
43 export class SeamPassInputError extends Error {
44   constructor(message) {
45     super(`SeamPassInputError: ${message}`);
46     this.name = 'SeamPassInputError';
47   }
48 }
49 
50 function isPlainObject(v) {
51   return v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
52 }
53 function isNonEmptyString(v) {
54   return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '';
55 }
56 
57 const _RUNGS = ['REFUTED', 'UNVERIFIED', 'CLAIMED', 'CORROBORATED', 'OBSERVED'];
58 const _VALUES = ['low', 'medium', 'high'];
59 const _SEVERITIES = ['minor', 'major', 'critical'];
60 const _KINDS = ['diagnose', 'situate', 'anticipate', 'nitpick'];
61 // Real models reach for reasonable SYNONYMS the committed enum doesn't list
62 // (e.g. severity "moderate"/"info"). Map the common ones to the nearest committed
63 // value; an unmappable value is dropped (the field is optional) rather than failing
64 // the whole read on a strict enum reject.
65 const _SEVERITY_SYNONYMS = {
66   moderate: 'major', medium: 'major', med: 'major', high: 'critical',
67   severe: 'critical', blocker: 'critical', fatal: 'critical',
68   info: 'minor', informational: 'minor', note: 'minor', nit: 'minor',
69   low: 'minor', trivial: 'minor', cosmetic: 'minor',
70 };
71 function _asString(v) {
72   return typeof v === 'string' ? v : (v === undefined || v === null ? '' : String(v));
73 }
74 
75 /** Coerce ONE item to the schema's required-key shape AND sanitize its enum fields, WITHOUT inventing
76  *  content: a missing/blank id gets a stable positional id; a missing/invalid rung honestly defaults to
77  *  UNVERIFIED; reasoning + verdict are guaranteed present as strings (preserving the reasoning-BEFORE-
78  *  verdict key order the canary enforces); an out-of-enum `severity` is mapped from a known synonym
79  *  (moderate→major, info→minor, …) or dropped; an out-of-enum `kind` is dropped (→ a generic finding).
80  *  Every other key (gandalf_core, future_state_condition, tier, value_if_true, …) is kept. THIS is what
81  *  makes the host robust to a real model run that omits a field OR uses an off-enum synonym on an item —
82  *  the read survives instead of the whole run failing on a strict-validation reject. */
83 function ensureItemKeys(item, index, prefix) {
84   const id = isNonEmptyString(item.id) ? item.id : `${prefix}${index}`;
85   const rung = _RUNGS.includes(item.rung) ? item.rung : 'UNVERIFIED';
86   const rest = { ...item };
87   delete rest.id; delete rest.rung; delete rest.reasoning; delete rest.verdict;
88   // Sanitize enum fields the committed schema would reject (preserve the item, not the bad value).
89   if ('severity' in rest) {
90     const s = typeof rest.severity === 'string' ? rest.severity.toLowerCase().trim() : '';
91     if (_SEVERITIES.includes(s)) rest.severity = s;
92     else if (_SEVERITY_SYNONYMS[s]) rest.severity = _SEVERITY_SYNONYMS[s];
93     else delete rest.severity; // unknown → drop (optional field)
94   }
95   if ('kind' in rest && !_KINDS.includes(rest.kind)) delete rest.kind; // invalid kind → generic finding
96   // id, rung, then the rest, then reasoning, then verdict (reasoning before verdict — load-bearing).
97   return { id, rung, ...rest, reasoning: _asString(item.reasoning), verdict: _asString(item.verdict) };
98 }
99 
100 /** Validate the RAW draft shape. We require only the structural minimum a read needs — a plain object
101  *  with a non-empty `reasoning` + `verdict` (the headline a real model reliably emits). The three item
102  *  arrays are COERCED to [] when absent (a model that emits no nitpicks is not an error) and each item
103  *  is normalized per-item below, so an imperfect-but-real draft yields a graded read rather than a
104  *  whole-run failure. Genuinely empty/garbage input still fails honestly (SeamPassInputError). */
105 function validateRawDraft(rawDraft) {
106   if (!isPlainObject(rawDraft)) {
107     throw new SeamPassInputError('the raw draft must be a plain object (got ' + (rawDraft === null ? 'null' : Array.isArray(rawDraft) ? 'array' : typeof rawDraft) + ')');
108   }
109   if (!isNonEmptyString(rawDraft.reasoning)) {
110     throw new SeamPassInputError("the raw draft must carry a non-empty 'reasoning' string (reasoning-before-verdict)");
111   }
112   if (!isNonEmptyString(rawDraft.verdict)) {
113     throw new SeamPassInputError("the raw draft must carry a non-empty 'verdict' string");
114   }
115 }
116 
117 /** True iff `item` ran degraded. */
118 function itemDegraded(item) {
119   return isPlainObject(item) && item.degraded === true;
120 }
121 
122 /** Turn ONE raw finding into its seam-stamped, schema-conformant finding by `kind`. Throws
123  *  SeamPassInputError on a malformed finding (a non-object, or one the seam refuses) — never fabricates. */
124 function passFinding(raw, index) {
125   if (!isPlainObject(raw)) {
126     throw new SeamPassInputError(`findings[${index}] is not an object`);
127   }
128   const kind = raw.kind;
129   try {
130     if (kind === 'diagnose') {
131       // The vetted-core diagnosis keeps its rung; the seam appends gandalf_core provenance.
132       return stampDiagnoseCoreProvenance(raw);
133     }
134     if (kind === 'anticipate') {
135       // composeAnticipation enforces subject_cardinality:1 + a populated future-state + enabling
136       // assumption (B3 + B9), and refuses any Oranges-engine field. It mints a FRESH finding from
137       // the raw stages, so we pass the raw fields straight through.
138       const composed = composeAnticipation({
139         id: raw.id,
140         future_state_condition: raw.future_state_condition,
141         enabling_assumption: raw.enabling_assumption,
142         reasoning: raw.reasoning,
143         verdict: raw.verdict,
144         rung: raw.rung ?? 'UNVERIFIED',
145         severity: raw.severity,
146       });
147       // Preserve an honest per-item degraded flag the seam does not carry (B6 rolls it up).
148       if (raw.degraded === true) composed.degraded = true;
149       return composed;
150     }
151     if (kind === 'situate') {
152       // composeSituate runs the SITUATE honesty caps (no self-CORROBORATED; unverifiable → handoff).
153       // Tier-1 has no live researchPrime commission, so facts_verified is false by construction and
154       // the seam attaches the needs_verification handoff itself.
155       const composed = composeSituate({
156         id: raw.id,
157         abstraction: raw.abstraction,
158         commission: raw.commission,
159         structure_map: raw.structure_map,
160         outside_view_base_rate: raw.outside_view_base_rate,
161         reasoning: raw.reasoning,
162         verdict: raw.verdict,
163         facts_verified: false, // Tier-1: no independent commission ran ⇒ never self-verified
164       });
165       if (raw.degraded === true) composed.degraded = true;
166       return composed;
167     }
168     // Any other finding kind (incl. a bare nitpick-shaped finding) passes through untouched — the
169     // schema only gates diagnose/situate/anticipate provenance.
170     return { ...raw };
171   } catch (err) {
172     if (err instanceof SeamPassInputError) throw err;
173     // The seam refused this item (e.g. an anticipate finding missing its future-state, or a situate
174     // finding missing its structure map) — a real model draft will sometimes do this. Don't fail the
175     // whole run: PRESERVE the content as a GENERIC finding (strip the leg `kind` + any half-formed
176     // provenance so no leg-specific canary applies); it is normalized to the required keys downstream.
177     const { kind: _k, gandalf_core: _gc, ...generic } = raw;
178     return generic;
179   }
180 }
181 
182 /** Turn ONE raw elevation into its seam-graded elevation. Every elevation runs through
183  *  `vetElevationRefutation`: an honestly-refuted elevation keeps its tier and gets its DERIVED
184  *  `cross_family_refuted` flag (from the injected ledger resolver); an un-refuted one downgrades to
185  *  SPECULATIVE + the no-independent-refutation stamp.
186  *
187  *  W2b: the tier ceiling is keyed off the DERIVED per-elevation cross-family eligibility, NOT any
188  *  caller flag. `labelTier` is called with `cross_model: <the elevation's own derived eligibility>`,
189  *  so ONLY an elevation with a genuine ledger-bound, family-distinct, digest-matched refutation may
190  *  reach the cross-family (GROUNDED) tier; every other elevation is capped at PROMISING. Returns null
191  *  when the elevation drops (rung REFUTED). Throws on a non-object. */
192 function passElevation(raw, index, resolveCommission) {
193   if (!isPlainObject(raw)) {
194     throw new SeamPassInputError(`elevations[${index}] is not an object`);
195   }
196   // Only REFUTED drops (the single drop condition).
197   if (dropsFromOutput(raw)) return null;
198   const degraded = raw.degraded === true;
199   let vetted = vetElevationRefutation(raw, { resolveCommission });
200   // DERIVED cross-family eligibility — the SOLE key to the GROUNDED ceiling (never the caller flag).
201   const crossFamilyEligible = vetted.cross_family_refuted === true;
202   const { dropped, tier } = labelTier(vetted, { cross_model: crossFamilyEligible });
203   if (dropped) return null;
204   const out = { ...vetted, tier };
205   if (degraded) out.degraded = true;
206   return out;
207 }

209 /**
210  * applySeamPass — the deterministic Tier-1 host composer.
211  *
212  * Turn a model's RAW draft ({ reasoning, verdict, findings[], nitpicks[], elevations[] } with
213  * un-stamped items) into a canary-conformant, honestly-graded advisor output by applying ONLY the
214  * shipped seams. PURE (returns a fresh object; does not mutate `rawDraft`). Single-family by default
215  * (cross_model:false) ⇒ the PROMISING ceiling.
216  *
217  * W2b ANTI-OVERCLAIM DERIVATION: the top-level `cross_model` stamp is DERIVED, never caller-set. It
218  * is true IFF at least one shipped elevation carries a genuine ledger-bound, family-distinct,
219  * digest-matched refutation (its DERIVED `cross_family_refuted` flag from vetElevationRefutation).
220  * The incoming `cross_model` flag is an INTENT only — recorded as `cross_model_requested` — and can
221  * NEVER by itself set the output stamp true or lift any tier ceiling.
222  *
223  * PER-RUN LEDGER (replay-hardening): when no `resolveCommission` is injected, this run instantiates a
224  * FRESH ledger via createCommissionLedger() and threads ITS resolver — NEVER the module-default
225  * singleton. This kills the cross-run state leak (an id minted on the shared singleton by one run can
226  * never resolve inside another). The fresh ledger's minted-this-run set is empty until the live minter
227  * lands (W3), so a Tier-1 run authenticates nothing — the honest single-family behavior — while W3's
228  * minter will mint on THIS same per-run ledger. A test may inject a stub via `opts.resolveCommission`.
229  *
230  * @param {object} rawDraft
231  * @param {{cross_model?: boolean, resolveCommission?: Function}} [opts]
232  * @returns {object} a conformant output that passes `assertIncrement1Conformant`.
233  * @throws {SeamPassInputError} on a malformed/partial draft — no partial output is returned.
234  */
235 export function applySeamPass(rawDraft, { cross_model = false, resolveCommission } = {}) {
236   validateRawDraft(rawDraft);
237   const crossModelRequested = cross_model === true; // the caller INTENT — never the stamp itself
238   // A FRESH per-run ledger (no module-default singleton state leak). The injection seam wins: tests and
239   // future callers may pass an explicit resolver; otherwise this run resolves against its own ledger.
240   const resolve = typeof resolveCommission === 'function'
241     ? resolveCommission
242     : createCommissionLedger().resolveCommission;
243 
244   // The three item arrays are coerced to [] when the model omitted them (lenient input).
245   const rawFindings = Array.isArray(rawDraft.findings) ? rawDraft.findings : [];
246   const rawNitpicks = Array.isArray(rawDraft.nitpicks) ? rawDraft.nitpicks : [];
247   const rawElevations = Array.isArray(rawDraft.elevations) ? rawDraft.elevations : [];
248 
249   // --- findings: dispatch by kind through the shipped seams; drop only REFUTED -----------------
250   // 2026-08-25 (John-ratified card — journals 0301/0303: killed/dropped items left NO record,
251   // so a kill was indistinguishable from a silent omission — an honesty hole in an honesty
252   // engine): every drop is RECORDED with its reason in output.kill_log (below the fold).
253   const killLog = { findings: [], nitpicks: [], elevations: [] };
254   const briefOf = (raw) => String(raw?.topic ?? raw?.claim ?? raw?.message ?? raw?.id ?? '(untitled)').slice(0, 120);
255   const findings = [];
256   let anyDegraded = false;
257   rawFindings.forEach((raw, i) => {
258     if (!isPlainObject(raw)) { killLog.findings.push({ index: i, reason: 'not an object' }); return; }
259     if (dropsFromOutput(raw)) { killLog.findings.push({ index: i, brief: briefOf(raw), reason: 'REFUTED — rung refuted by its refutation record' }); return; }
260     const passed = passFinding(raw, i); // never throws now (a seam refusal → a generic finding)
261     if (itemDegraded(passed)) anyDegraded = true;
262     findings.push(ensureItemKeys(passed, i, 'f'));
263   });
264 
265   // --- nitpicks: normalize to the required keys; skip non-objects; drop REFUTED -----------------
266   const nitpicks = [];
267   rawNitpicks.forEach((raw, i) => {
268     if (!isPlainObject(raw)) { killLog.nitpicks.push({ index: i, reason: 'not an object' }); return; }
269     if (dropsFromOutput(raw)) { killLog.nitpicks.push({ index: i, brief: briefOf(raw), reason: 'REFUTED — rung refuted by its refutation record' }); return; }
270     if (itemDegraded(raw)) anyDegraded = true;
271     nitpicks.push(ensureItemKeys(raw, i, 'n'));
272   });
273 
274   // --- elevations: vet refutation (SPECULATIVE floor) → label tier; drop REFUTED ----------------
275   const elevations = [];
276   let anyCrossFamily = false; // W2b: DERIVES the top-level cross_model — set only by a genuine refutation
277   rawElevations.forEach((raw, i) => {
278     if (!isPlainObject(raw)) { killLog.elevations.push({ index: i, reason: 'not an object' }); return; }
279     let passed;
280     try {
281       passed = passElevation(raw, i, resolve);
282     } catch (e) {
283       // an un-salvageable elevation is dropped, never fatal to the run — but RECORDED
284       killLog.elevations.push({ index: i, brief: briefOf(raw), reason: `un-salvageable: ${e?.message ?? e}` });
285       return;
286     }
287     if (passed === null) {
288       // dropped (REFUTED) — record WHY, incl. the refutation's named defeater when present
289       const defeater = raw?.refutation_provenance?.defeater ?? null;
290       killLog.elevations.push({ index: i, brief: briefOf(raw), reason: 'REFUTED — the named defeater landed', defeater });
291       return;
292     }
293     if (passed.cross_family_refuted === true) anyCrossFamily = true; // a real ledger-bound refutation
294     if (itemDegraded(passed)) anyDegraded = true;
295     // Guarantee a valid value_if_true (required enum) before normalizing the rest.
296     if (!_VALUES.includes(passed.value_if_true)) passed = { ...passed, value_if_true: 'low' };
297     elevations.push(ensureItemKeys(passed, i, 'e'));
298   });
299 
300   // --- assemble the partial output, then synthesize honest risk_labels over it ------------------
301   // B6: if any item ran degraded, OR the draft itself declared degraded, the top level owns it.
302   const degraded = anyDegraded || rawDraft.degraded === true;
303 
304   // W2b: cross_model is DERIVED — true IFF a shipped elevation earned a genuine cross-family
305   // refutation. The caller's intent flag is recorded separately and never sets this true.
306   const output = {
307     schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION,
308     cross_model: anyCrossFamily === true,
309     cross_model_requested: crossModelRequested,
310     degraded,
311     reasoning: rawDraft.reasoning, // reasoning BEFORE verdict (key order is load-bearing)
312     verdict: rawDraft.verdict,
313     findings,
314     nitpicks,
315     elevations,
316     risk_labels: [], // filled below from the finalized findings
317   };
318   // composeRiskLabels reads the finalized findings: one label per present leg, envelope rung,
319   // PROMISING ceiling on a single-family run.
320   output.risk_labels = composeRiskLabels(output);
321 
322   // Kill log rides below the fold (additive; schema additionalProperties:true) — John sees
323   // WHY each recommendation died, and a kill is never confusable with a silent omission.
324   output.kill_log = killLog;
325 
326   return output;
327 }
